bio: When the Academy's astromancers birthed Quadrax, they didn't expect a Titan formed from intense study of the cosmos to be so... buff. Usually exercise-adverse Magi who have Invoked Quadrax are astonished by the Titan's power – they feel like they can punch through galaxies and bench-press stars. Some have been so inspired by Quadrax, they've even started hitting the gym.
